title: LoRA增强对比学习与SAS视觉Transformer
summary: 研究将DINOv3 ViT模型适配于水下合成孔径声纳自动目标识别，采用三阶段参数高效框架。LoRA微调将AUPRC从0.300提升至0.679，仅训练0.26%权重。但硬负样本挖掘和监督对比学习阶段均未超过对照组，表明单一高效适配阶段已足够。
summary_en: This work adapts DINOv3 ViT models to underwater synthetic aperture sonar ATR via a three-stage parameter-efficient framework. LoRA raises AUPRC from 0.300 to 0.679 while training only 0.26% of weights, but hard-negative mining and supervised contrastive learning stages do not outperform matched controls, showing one efficient adaptation stage suffices.
